transcript.content: Hello, welcome to the clinic. I'm Dr. [Your Name]. Can you tell me what brings you in today?

Um… I guess I came in because there’s been something going on that I can’t really explain without it sounding strange. I’ve been pretty convinced that one of my MBA classmates and this startup advisor are sort of… coordinating opportunities for me. Like certain comments in class, or messages on Slack, feel coded—like they’re signals about where my career is supposed to go.
Can you tell me more about why you believe these people are sending you signals? Have you noticed any specific patterns or events that make you feel this way?

It’s mostly… the way things line up. Like a classmate will say something in class that feels too specific, and then later the startup advisor posts or messages something on Slack that seems connected. I know it sounds strange, but it feels coded, like they’re pointing me toward certain opportunities or telling me what direction I’m supposed to take.

Have you noticed any other experiences that feel unusual or hard to explain—like thoughts that come into your mind that don’t feel like your own, or seeing or hearing things that others might not notice?

Um… yeah, a little. Not seeing things, really. But sometimes when I’m working late—like on school stuff or operations plans—I’ll hear my name, or just a short phrase. Like… “go now.” It’s clear enough that I check my phone or look around, but there isn’t anyone there. It doesn’t happen all the time. Maybe a few times a week.
Have you ever felt that thoughts are being placed in your mind, or that events or messages are specifically directed at you in a way others don’t seem to notice?

I don’t know about thoughts being placed there… not exactly.

But yeah, the messages thing. I feel like some comments in class or Slack posts aren’t just random. Like my MBA classmate and the startup advisor are… quietly coordinating things for me. It feels like coded signals about where I’m supposed to go with my career. I know that probably sounds odd.
Have you ever felt that someone was putting thoughts into your mind, or that your thoughts weren’t entirely your own?
Not really… I don’t think so. My thoughts feel like mine, even if I get confused about what things mean sometimes. I haven’t noticed someone putting them there.
Have you ever felt that someone was trying to communicate with you by placing specific thoughts directly into your mind, rather than through outside signals like comments or messages?
No… I don’t think so. Not like thoughts being put straight into my head. It feels more like I’m reading into things outside of me, if that makes sense.

When you notice these comments or messages that you feel are directed at you, do you ever think that others might not see them as meaningful, or do you feel certain that they are intentionally meant for you?

I mean… part of me knows other people probably wouldn’t take them that way.

But when it happens, it feels pretty clear to me. Like the comments in class or a Slack message aren’t just random — they’re meant for me. I’ve been really convinced my classmate and this startup advisor are kind of coordinating things, like signals about what career move I’m supposed to make.
Have you ever felt that things happening around you—like events, people’s actions, or even things on TV—were specifically directed at you, even if others didn’t see it that way?

Yeah… that’s kind of why I came in. I know it sounds hard to explain, but I’ve been really convinced that certain things — like comments in class or Slack messages — are meant for me.

It feels like one of my MBA classmates and a startup advisor are… quietly coordinating opportunities, or sending coded signals about where my career is supposed to go. Other people probably wouldn’t see it that way, but to me it feels directed.
Have you ever felt that random events, like something on TV or a stranger’s action, were specifically about you or directed at you, even if they didn’t seem related to you logically?

Not really TV or strangers so much. It’s more… with people around my MBA program. Like certain class comments or Slack messages feel coded, like they’re meant for me.

I know it sounds odd, but I came in because I’ve been pretty convinced my classmate and a startup advisor are quietly coordinating opportunities for me, kind of pointing me toward where my career is supposed to go.
Have you ever felt that something completely unrelated to you, like a stranger's actions, a TV show, or a random event, was actually about you or directed at you in some way?

Not really with TV shows or random strangers. It’s more… people connected to my MBA program.

Like I’ve felt certain that a classmate and a startup advisor were coordinating things for me — through comments in class or Slack messages, like signals about where my career should go. I know that sounds strange.
Have you ever felt that things people say or do in public—like something on TV, in a movie, or something a stranger says—are secretly about you or meant for you?

Not really TV or movies, no. It’s more… people I actually know, like in my MBA program.

I came in because I’ve been really convinced that one classmate and a startup advisor are sort of coordinating opportunities for me. Like certain class comments or Slack messages feel coded, like they’re meant to point me toward where my career is supposed to go. I know that sounds… strange.
Do you feel that the signals or messages you’re receiving have a special or unique meaning that only you can understand, like they’re meant specifically for you and no one else?

Yeah… I think so. It feels like the comments or Slack messages aren’t just general — like they’re kind of coded for me, about where I’m supposed to go career-wise. It’s mostly that classmate and the startup advisor. I know it sounds hard to explain.

Have you ever felt that events or actions that don’t involve you directly — like things happening in the world, strangers’ behaviors, or random occurrences — were actually about you or had a special meaning for you?

Not really with strangers or world events. It’s more people I know.

Have you ever felt that events or actions that don’t seem related to you at all — like something happening in the world or someone you don’t know doing something — were actually connected to you or had a hidden meaning for you?

Not really… not with strangers or world stuff. It’s more specific people I know. Like I said, I’ve been pretty convinced my classmate and that startup advisor are… kind of coordinating things for me. Certain class comments or Slack messages feel like they’re coded, like they’re pointing me toward what I’m supposed to do career-wise.

Yeah… mostly. It’s not like strangers or the whole world. It’s more those specific people — my classmate and the startup advisor. Their comments or Slack messages just feel… intentional, like they’re trying to point me toward certain opportunities.
Have you ever felt that people you don’t know well or don’t interact with at all are also sending you messages or trying to communicate with you in some way?

No… not really people I don’t know. It’s more the classmate and the startup advisor I mentioned. Their comments or Slack messages feel like they’re… coded somehow, like they’re pointing me toward certain career opportunities.
